description: Control scan: rank the conserved histidine quartet against every spatially clustered 4-residue donor set in the PP_0908 model by metal-fit quality
code:
import requests, itertools, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.optimize import minimize

af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q88PE2",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(af["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
rec=[(l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
     for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM")]
A=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=["name","res","num","x","y","z","b"])

# every potential metal-donor side-chain atom in the protein
DON={"HIS":["ND1","NE2"],"ASP":["OD1","OD2"],"GLU":["OE1","OE2"],"CYS":["SG"],"MET":["SD"]}
pool=[]
for _,r in A.iterrows():
    if r.res in DON and r["name"] in DON[r.res]:
        pool.append((f"{r.res[0]}{r.num}.{r['name']}", r.num, r.res, np.array([r.x,r.y,r.z])))
P=pd.DataFrame(pool,columns=["label","num","res","xyz"])
print("candidate donor atoms in the model:",len(P),"from",P.num.nunique(),"residues")
nHis=(P.res=="HIS").sum()//2
print("histidines in the model:",nHis)

IDEAL=2.15
def fit(pts):
    f=lambda m: np.sum((np.linalg.norm(pts-m,axis=1)-IDEAL)**2)
    r=minimize(f,np.mean(pts,axis=0),method="Nelder-Mead",
               options={"xatol":1e-4,"fatol":1e-8,"maxiter":4000})
    d=np.linalg.norm(pts-r.x,axis=1)
    return r.x,d,float(np.sqrt(np.mean((d-IDEAL)**2)))

# enumerate every 4-residue donor set whose atoms are mutually within 9 A, one atom per residue
X=np.vstack(P.xyz.values)
resnums=sorted(P.num.unique())
bycent={n:np.mean(np.vstack(P[P.num==n].xyz.values),axis=0) for n in resnums}
cands=[]
for quad in itertools.combinations(resnums,4):
    c=np.array([bycent[n] for n in quad])
    if max(np.linalg.norm(c[i]-c[j]) for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(4),2))>9.0: continue
    cands.append(quad)
print("spatially clustered 4-residue donor sets (all centroid pairs <9 A):",len(cands))

rows=[]
for quad in cands:
    best=None
    for combo in itertools.product(*[list(P[P.num==n].itertuples()) for n in quad]):
        pts=np.array([c.xyz for c in combo])
        if max(np.linalg.norm(pts[i]-pts[j]) for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(4),2))>7.0: continue
        m,d,rm=fit(pts)
        if best is None or rm<best[0]: best=(rm,[c.label for c in combo],m,d)
    if best is None: continue
    rows.append(dict(residues="+".join("%s%d"%(P[P.num==n].res.iloc[0][0],n) for n in quad),
                     rmsd=best[0], donors=",".join(best[1]),
                     n_his=sum(1 for n in quad if P[P.num==n].res.iloc[0]=="HIS")))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("rmsd").reset_index(drop=True)
R.to_csv("PP_0908_metal_site_control_scan.csv",index=False)

TARGET="H67+H114+H224+H361"
hit=R[R.residues==TARGET]
rank=int(hit.index[0])+1 if len(hit) else None
print("\ntotal sets scored: %d"%len(R))
print("conserved quartet %s: RMSD %.3f A, rank %s of %d (percentile %.1f)"%(
    TARGET, hit.rmsd.iloc[0], rank, len(R), 100*(1-rank/len(R))))
print("\ntop 8 sets in the whole protein:")
print(R.head(8).to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
ax[0].hist(R.rmsd,bins=40,color="#bbbbbb",edgecolor="white")
ax[0].axvline(hit.rmsd.iloc[0],color="#b2182b",lw=2)
ax[0].text(hit.rmsd.iloc[0]+0.03,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.85,
           "H67+H114+H224+H361\nRMSD %.2f A, rank %d/%d"%(hit.rmsd.iloc[0],rank,len(R)),
           color="#b2182b",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("RMSD of fitted metal-donor distance from 2.15 A"); ax[0].set_ylabel("number of donor sets")
ax[0].set_title("All %d clustered 4-residue donor sets in the PP_0908 model"%len(R),fontsize=10)

top=R.head(15).iloc[::-1]
cols=["#b2182b" if r.residues==TARGET else "#999999" for r in top.itertuples()]
ax[1].barh(range(len(top)),top.rmsd,color=cols)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(top))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(top.residues,fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("fit RMSD (A)"); ax[1].set_title("15 best-fitting donor sets",fontsize=10)
for s in ["top","right"]:
    ax[0].spines[s].set_visible(False); ax[1].spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
